headline: Democrats Win U.S. House and Senate Majority in Midterm Elections
summary: A sweeping Democratic takeover of the U.S. Congress stripped the administration of its unchecked legislative control following midterm elections that served as a referendum on White House policies.
why: Congressional shifts in the United States alter the federal legislative agenda, budget allocations, and regulatory oversight, impacting broad macroeconomic expectations and domestic financial markets.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Loss of unified control in Congress reshapes domestic legislative power and executive policy implementation.
